notes.title: Dev Log Update
notes.content:
Hello all,

We thought we would drop a update to steam news on what the devs have been upto over the last few months. Lots of work has been going on behind closed doors. (Discord!) Below is a list of Steam updates we have been dropping for the closed beta testers in discord. 

Update 0.11.2 Now Live.
Currency
Buy/Sell (at a value now)
Weapon & Equipment Vendors (Added to the Safezone)
Item Vendors  (Added to the Safezone)
Extended Road Network
Melee Weapons (Wider Choice)
Resources Value (Gold/Iron now has Vendor Value)

Update 0.11.3 Now Live.
Save system Rework.
Weapon & Equipment Vendors Currency Values Updated.

Update 0.11.2 Now Live.
Craftables Updated.
Building System Rework.
Wood Planks (For Building)
Nails (For Building)
New Melees Added (Large Axe, Bared Wire Baseball Bat, Cricket Bat, Homemade Axe, Nail Baseball Bat, Homemade Pickaxe)
Bench Hammer - Upgrade/Remove Building Parts
Vendor List Updated.
Mechanics Component UI Rework.

Update 0.11.3 Now Live.
Character Attribute/Health States. 
(More info here ⁠chat⁠) Discord
Character Weather Temperature States.
(Weather now effects the character) 
Vendor & Inventory Items now updated for Attributes/Health states. I.E Get sick, use medic kit to remove the sick state. Other items remove other states within the world.
Character Weather interaction. I.E foot & puddle/snow trails.
Deer Hunting Rework.

Update 0.12.0 Now Live.
Skill system expanded.
Attributes  expanded. 
(You will only get attribute points to spend on stats for every character level you earn.)
(Each skill level you earn gives you 50 xp points onto the character skill.)
Skills now have a growth factor.
Skill levels start from 0 - 150 max level. (Subject to a higher max level)
Issue reported from beta test 06/01/2025 now fixed. (Only first connected player would earn everybody's skill points on a dedicated server environment)

Update 0.12.1 Now Live.
Character Voice now replicates to the owning client. (dedicated server environment) Beta Test Report 9/1/2025
Quick slots work as intended by the equipment you have on. (dedicated server environment) Beta Test Report 9/1/2025
Other known issues. Pending Patch.

Update 0.12.2 Now Live.
Added Weather Volume SFX Slider
Full Menu UI Rework
Fixed weapon slots missing quick slot binds
Fixed Missing Quick Slots for Starting Equipment
Fixed Dedicated Server Error
Fixed Character Skin Mesh Clipping Though Clothing
Third Person Weapon Readjustment
New Interactive Foliage (Blueberries/Raspberries)
Removed Starting Items (Water bottle/Wood/Flashlight) 
Added Character Fixed Dialogue
Changes to Multiplayer Menu and dedicated player slot count.

If you would like to follow us closer, please join discord as most updates are posted there and not on Steam. 

You can join discord here: Discord Join Link
